notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: The claw is designed, not converted, so this part has no reference mesh and only its revised render is shown. Its outline is claw_gears.scad's, shared with the Claw Body and the Claw Cap, and its layout along y is claw_params.scad's. It prints standing on its front lip, open upward, with no supports. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the render is its output.
